# bloxone_cdc_applications (Data Source)

Retrieves information about existing Applications.

The Application object represents a Cloud Data Connector (CDC) application, such as a Python script, that can process flow data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get CDC Applications filtered by an attribute
data "bloxone_cdc_applications" "example_by_attribute" {
  filters = {
    name = "example_cdc_application"
  }
}

# Get CDC Applications filtered by tag
data "bloxone_cdc_applications" "example_by_tag" {
  tag_filters = {
    site = "Site A"
  }
}

# Get all CDC Applications
data "bloxone_cdc_applications" "example_all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) Filter are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes, e.g. name. If you specify multiple filters, the results returned will have only resources that match all the specified filters.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Tag Filters are used to return a more specific list of results filtered by tags. If you specify multiple filters, the results returned will have only resources that match all the specified filters.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Required:

- `data` (String) The application data containing the scripts, as a JSON-encoded object, e.g. `jsonencode({ scripts = [{ filename = "script_1.py", content = file("script_1.py") }] })`. The value is stored exactly as configured; the data returned by the backend is available in _file_data_.
- `name` (String) The name of the application.

Optional:

- `description` (String) The description of the application.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether the application is enabled.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the application.
- `variables` (Map of String) The variables for the application.

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Time when the object has been created.
- `file_data` (String) The application data as returned by the backend, as a JSON-encoded object.
- `id` (Number) The resource identifier.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) The tags for the application, including default tags.
- `type` (String) The type of the application.
- `updated_at` (String) Time when the object has been updated. Equals to _created_at_ if not updated after creation.
